item.title: New Container: craft-apps
item.description:
We have released a new container for craft-apps!

Artcraft Craft Apps is a suite of open source creative applications written in Rust. This image bundles PhotoCraft (image editor), VectorCraft (vector illustration), FilmCraft (video editor), LightCraft (photo library and raw developer), PdfCraft (PDF workbench), EffectCraft (motion graphics and VFX compositor) and DesignCraft (page layout and publishing) in a single desktop.
